about: React Native's Image on OxyOS (images.h, sample/ImageProbe.tsx): the repository's test JPEG (assets/test-images/p3-5120x2880.jpg: 5120 x 2880 with a Display P3 profile) covering its box, an app icon of the shell (a 192 x 192 PNG with transparency) contained in a rounded box and the same icon tinted, each reporting its load with the bitmap's size as Android does; a data: URI holding a cut PNG (decoded as Android decodes data: URIs) and a missing file failing with their reasons (remote images are remote-images.json's); and Image.getSize on the wallpaper. The output is checked at five points: two of the JPEG in sRGB (near its pink stop, #ff2d6f in Display P3, whose green the conversion to sRGB takes to nothing), the icon's centre, the tinted icon (exactly its tint) and the data: URI's box (nothing drawn).
